text:
Type: clear glass bottle vase
Use: holding a single stem or a few flowers on a table, shelf or windowsill; dining room, living room, kitchen
Style: farmhouse, Scandinavian, minimalist
Materials: thin clear glass, ribbed lip at the mouth
Colors: clear, colorless transparent
Shape: milk bottle silhouette with a straight cylindrical body, sloping shoulders and a narrow neck with a ribbed rim, slender and light
Feel: simple, fresh, airy, vintage
Goes with: wildflowers, green stems, light wood, white walls; farmhouse, Scandinavian or minimalist rooms
